experiment: Exp 3, leakage control on the d=3 patch's flags, X ancillas and relays (ibm_kingston, 14 October 2026)

arms.B: H, two CZs with each usual partner, H, measure, reset
arms.C: as A, reset replaced by a wait

method: followup.leakage_control.analyze as written (references per job, 0/1/outside at Mahalanobis 4, third cluster at Delta BIC > 10 and beyond both clouds, two-state HMM per qubit and arm, 200 bootstrap reps, seed 0), at the period of IBM's schedule. Beside it, not pre-registered: where the persistent state reads in IQ, pi against the steady occupancy, coincidences of qubits that share a CZ partner, the third cloud's share of the persistent state and a three-state model (N, F reading 0/1, L reading the third cloud).

findings.third_cluster: Small. Outside both reference clouds: 0.02%-0.16% of a qubit's readouts (references: at most 5 of 2000). Where it is fitted it sits next to |1>, about 0.6 of the 0-1 separation off the axis (along 0.9-1.4, across 0.5-0.8). The pre-registered test accepts it for A [71, 91], B [91], C [71, 75, 91, 93]; elsewhere Delta BIC is often large but the cloud lies within 4 sigma of |1>.
findings.persistent_state: Present in all 10 qubits in A and B (7 of 10 in C). It reads 1 0.64 / 0 0.27 / outside 0.017 in A and 1 0.58 / 0 0.41 / outside 0.012 in B (medians); its 1s sit on the |1> reference cloud in 8 of 10 qubits. Only relays 55 and 75 in A are mostly the third cloud (88% and 55%), and their onsets are the smallest (0.01% and 0.04% a cycle).
findings.causes: CZs 0.439% a cycle [0.364%, 0.503%], 0.090% per CZ [0.080%, 0.104%], positive in every qubit; reset 0.036% [0.001%, 0.058%] and readout and idle 0.112% [0.085%, 0.198%] over the 6 qubits arm C can see (q89's reset part, 0.26%, is C failing the contrast rule, not a reset). The as-read bounds from C are uninformative (reset at least < 0).
findings.third_cloud_onset: Three-state model, qubits where its L state reads the third cloud: onset 0.0103% (A), 0.0231% (B), 0.0050% (C) a cycle, lifetime 119 / 27 / 100 us: a few % of the persistent state's onset.
findings.stationarity: In A the state is at its steady level at the first readout (pi / [a/(a+b)] median 1.07) and stays flat over the 30 cycles, though 250 us separate shots, 2-14 of its lifetimes. pi's 95% interval lies above what onsets inside circuits alone (A's rate, two IBM resets) could leave in 9 of 10 qubits [51, 53, 69, 71, 73, 75, 89, 91, 93]: the A state also starts between shots.
findings.shared_partners: In B, qubits that share a CZ partner are in the state together (median correlation 0.132 against 0.009 without; 16% of a qubit's occupancy beyond chance, a lower bound), and its occupancy rises over the shot in 8 of 10 qubits. In A and C they are not (0.010, 0.011), except 69 and 71 through partner 70 (12-27% in every arm).
findings.run1: Run 1 (ibm_fez): a 2.5% a round, T_p 31 us, u1 0.51. Arm B: lifetime 32 us (median, 20-77), reads 1 0.58 in the state; arm A: 40 us, 0.64. Exp 3's rates at run 1's rounds give 1.1% (flag) and 0.7% (relay) a round against 3.1% and 1.7%.

hypotheses.H1_cz_leakage: The CZs add half to nine tenths of the onset in B (median two thirds), about 0.09% per CZ, but what they add reads 0 and 1 at the computational clouds, is shared by qubits with a common partner, and builds over the shot: consistent with CZ-made leakage (or another non-computational state) of the partners, which no arm reads, not of the flags and relays. Their own third-cloud onset with CZs is about 0.02-0.05% a cycle.
hypotheses.H2_measurement_reset_leakage: Not supported: the reset adds at most about 0.04% a cycle, the A state is stationary across the 250 us between shots, and it reads 0 a quarter of the time. Third-cloud onset without CZs, about 0.01% a cycle, bounds leakage per readout and reset at about 1e-4. Readout and idle can't be split (every arm reads every cycle; arm D wasn't run), and stationarity assumes the state lives as long between shots as in the circuit.
hypotheses.H3_not_leakage: Supported for the state seen without CZs: tens of us during which H-wait-H returns 1 more often than 0, read on the computational clouds, local to each qubit (but 69 and 71 through 70), present between shots. A frequency shift of order 0.5-1 MHz over the 0.41 us wait (TLS, or a neighbour's state) fits; which one isn't decided.

run1.source: paper/main.tex, table of flag and relay readouts and App. H (ibm_fez, Z memory)
run1.note: Exp 3's onset per CZ and per us without CZs, at run 1's flag (8 CZs) and relay (3 CZs) rounds of 7.8 us; another chip and other qubits, so an order of magnitude only.
